profile.headline: Software Engineer in Test at Letter AI
profile.summary:
Hi, I’m Jason, an SDET at Letter AI. Before Letter, I was a product engineer at QA Wolf, where I helped build an AI agent that writes and maintains end-to-end tests. I worked on the parts of the product customers see and use, like the review flows and the live drafting experience.

Most of my recent work has been on the AI side: designing the prompts and tools the agent relies on, building an LLM classifier that defends against prompt extraction, and writing quality checks that let the agent catch and fix its own mistakes before publishing. It’s the part of the job I enjoy most, building products where a model does real work and the software around it makes that work reliable.

I came to engineering from finance and operations backgrounds, where I spent years using the kind of tools I now build.

Outside of work, you'll usually find me on a side project, climbing, at a DnB show, or hanging out with my dogs.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Product Engineer
positions.description:
• Contributed to the review and live drafting experiences for AI test generation, helping build the pages where customers watch the agent explore their app, review generated Playwright tests with diffs and run video, and publish them.
• Designed the company's first defense against system-prompt extraction, combining pattern matching with an LLM classifier.
• Built quality gates for AI-generated tests, including an open-source ESLint plugin the agent uses to fix its own violations before publishing.

positions.title: Automation Engineer
positions.description:
• Rebuilt the network-request reporting pipeline on BullMQ and Redis, eliminating the failures that had made reports unreliable for enterprise customers.
• Designed and built an internal experiment platform end to end: data model, APIs, UI, scheduler, and GrowthBook integration.
• Built bug-reporting and on-call routing automations in Slack and MS Teams, plus customer integrations with Jira, Linear, TestRail, and Qase.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Test Automation
positions.description:
• Led technical onboarding for enterprise trials: scoping applications, defining coverage plans, and building initial test suites.
• Maintained Playwright end-to-end suites across enterprise customers, triaging failures and reporting confirmed bugs with repro steps and video.

positions.title: Contributor for Website Design
positions.description: Designed and built the organization's WordPress site.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Automated the integration with ESRI geospatial databases in Python, replacing manual data exports.
• Integrated the Rubbish API with Zapier so clients could pull data into Salesforce, HubSpot, and QuickBooks.
• Built a chatbot on GPT-4 and Pinecone that let staff query company reports in plain language.
positions.insights: Skills: Vector Database · OpenAI · Generative AI · Prompt Engineering

positions.title: Manager of Operations
positions.description:
• Oversaw warehouse expansion from a 1,000 sq. ft. space to a 33,000 sq. ft. space, and led the planning and implementation of warehouse layout and equipment to optimize space utilization and support operational needs.
• Developed and implemented standard operating procedures across all warehouse functions, resulting in streamlined processes, improved productivity, and reduced shipping errors.
• Supervised and trained a team of 30-40 warehouse staff, ensuring proper staffing levels and cross-training to enhance team efficiency and versatility.
• Coordinated with cross-functional teams, including purchasing, logistics, and customer service, to oversee projects and ensure timelines were met, resulting in successful execution of projects and improved customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Associate Financial Representative
positions.description:
• Managed day-to-day operations for multiple advisors, ensuring smooth and efficient business activities, and allowing advisors to prioritize client engagement.
• Assisted in crafting actionable business plans and refining processes, leading to increased advisor productivity and enhanced revenue generation.
• Maintained and updated client records in Microsoft CRM, enhancing personalized client interactions and boosting client trust and satisfaction.
• Collaborated with teams to address and solve financial challenges, ensuring tailored solutions for individual, family, and business needs, thus bolstering client confidence in the firm's expertise.

positions.title: Financial Representative
positions.description: • Conducted in-depth financial assessments to identify growth opportunities and risks, managed tailored investment portfolios aligned with clients' objectives, and built enduring relationships through transparent communication, resulting in optimized returns, a secure financial future, a high client retention rate, and an expanded client base through referrals.

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description:
• Utilized Cantonese speaking ability in business interactions, fostering effective communication and enhancing IBM's regional rapport in Hong Kong.
• Tested IBM’s Advanced Messaging Service (AMS) for the Bank of East Asia, ensuring the software met client specifications and promoting smoother banking operations.
• Supported the Smart Marketing program and conference, contributing to a successful event attended by 70+ professors from diverse Chinese universities, enhancing IBM's academic and industry outreach.

projects.title: RecycleGPTWeb via AccelerateSF Hackathon
projects.description: • Created a web platform to make previous hackathon projects more accessible, using Eleven Labs and GPT Vision for real-time identification of recyclable items in San Francisco, with plans for broader applicability.

projects.title: RecycleGPT via GenLab Hackathon II
projects.description:
• Best Bootstrapped Org Award, GenLab Hackathon II
• Co-developed an award-winning recycling solution for high-traffic areas like airports and stadiums, leveraging OpenAI Vision APIs and Dalle3 technology within Firebase cloud functions.
• Implemented gamification with OpenAI Dalle3, creating user caricatures to enhance the recycling experience's interactivity.
• Successfully achieved a 56% improvement in recycling accuracy during its implementation at the hackathon, showcasing the solution's effectiveness in enhancing recycling practices in real-world scenarios.
